brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / illustrated Japanese editorial sports thumbnail.
Create exactly ONE finished landscape PNG thumbnail for the Japanese site バスケまとめ. Target canvas 1792 × 1008 pixels, 16:9, opaque background. This is an editorial illustration and typography asset, not a photograph.

Content grounding: the supplied frozen article compares Tokyo United and Shizuoka registered players using season-average EFF data as of approximately 2026-10-27 08:10. Their scheduled B.ONE matchup is on October 29 and 30. This is NOT a prediction of player appearances or match results. Do not invent scores or statistics. Do not depict any person.

Visual style: approved house style uses nearly black #151A18, vivid lime #CCF43B, warm off-white lettering, expressive hand-drawn black ink and dry-brush strokes, strong thick Japanese gothic headlines, very few elements. Use those qualities. A single large orange basketball rendered as a bold hand-inked illustration sits in the right third, with a few restrained court arcs and diagonal lime brush marks behind it. No human figures, faces, hands, silhouettes, jerseys, sponsor words or team logos. Plenty of breathing room. This is a flat editorial poster, no frame, no mockup.

Composition and hierarchy: a small brand and article date at the upper left; a small lime date/league ribbon below it; huge off-white matchup headline across the left and center; large readable two-line Japanese subheading; a modest source timestamp below. The basketball must not overlap any text. Put the nonprediction qualifier on a clear high-contrast line above the footer. Put the two required AI disclosure labels along the bottom with a generous safe margin. All text must fit inside the canvas with at least 60 px side margins and 45 px top/bottom margins. Keep Japanese letterforms clean, precisely spelled, and readable; place brush texture around the type, not across its strokes.

Render exactly these text strings, and no other text:
1. Small header: "バスケまとめ｜2026.10.27"
2. Date/league ribbon: "10/29・30｜B.ONE"
3. Largest main headline: "東京U × 静岡"
4. Bold secondary headline: "登録選手を比較"
5. Bold lime emphasis line: "今季平均EFF"
6. Source timestamp, smaller but legible: "データ：10/27 08:10ごろ"
7. Qualifier, clearly legible: "出場・勝敗の予測ではありません"
8. Bottom-left disclosure: "イラスト（AI生成）"
9. Bottom disclosure after a visible space: "成績をもとにしたイメージ"

Important: This is a new illustration. Do not import the player, name, score, or date from any style example. Do not add a score, probability, ranking, win/loss claim, named athlete or actual game scene. Preserve the exact Japanese wording, dates, colon and EFF letters. Make one polished, ready-to-use thumbnail only.
